gaps.next_text: All our enemies have fallen before us.

cues.text: Five white swords radiate across a deep red background. A white monument rises.
Scientists observe the bare-chested emperor, wired to machinery and glowing with energy. Darkness.

beats.note: Five stylized white swords point outwards against a deep red background.
The swords extend into long beams. A stylized white monument rises from the bottom.
The camera pulls back. An emperor in a black coat stands on the monument's balcony.
A vast crowd of red silhouettes stands below.
The emperor clenches his fist over his heart.
White petals drift down around him.
The red and white image glitches and tears.
A dark laboratory. The bare-chested emperor stands among glowing machinery, observed by scientists.
Cables plug into his torso. He clenches his fist over his heart.
Glowing yellow energy swirls around him.
